AI Overview
PayPal has established itself as a major trust and payment infrastructure provider for agentic commerce (where AI agents shop, buy, and pay autonomously on behalf of users) through key rollouts and partnerships spanning 2025 and 2026. 
Perspective AI
 +2
Core Offerings & Solutions
Agent Ready: A payment foundation enabling AI surfaces to accept and process native payments directly through existing PayPal accounts, complete with built-in fraud detection, risk management, and dispute resolution. 
PYPL Investor Relations
 +1
Store Sync: Catalog and order management tools (bolstered by PayPal's acquisition of Cymbio) that make merchant inventories discoverable and transacting directly inside AI platforms. 
www.bankingnewsai.com
 +1
Protocols & Governance: PayPal developed and adopted agent-friendly infrastructure like Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and the Agent Payment Protocol (AP2) to log every agent action auditably and enforce rules like transaction limits and approved merchants. 
YouTube
·Google Cloud
 +1
Key Partnerships (OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, & More)
OpenAI (October 2025): PayPal integrated directly into ChatGPT via the Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP). This allows ChatGPT users to complete instant checkouts using PayPal wallets, buyer/seller protections, and delegated payment controls. PayPal also scaled ChatGPT Enterprise across its own workforce. 
PayPal Newsroom
Google Cloud (2026): PayPal built its core AI stack and agentic commerce architecture on Google Cloud (utilizing Google Kubernetes Engine and Gemini Enterprise) to scale production models and handle nearly 1 billion requests daily. They also collaborate on trusted AI checkouts and agent payment protocols.

Microsoft & Perplexity: PayPal powers Copilot Checkout for Microsoft and instant buy features for Perplexity, letting brands reach shoppers natively inside conversational search and AI chat interfaces.
